purpose: ring-neuron dopamine stage 4 part A: encoder census and frozen position-code analysis
first_sentence: Position is an imposed TuBu label assigned by ascending root ID, not seen and not validated visual coordinates; the fly does not see.

part_a.historical_neural_outcome_use: only the contract-required stage 1--3 per-cell, per-seed 45-degree counts used to set synthetic count levels and variability; no encoder choice uses a neural outcome

mapping_source.kind: imposed geometric mapping, not independently supported TuBu receptive fields
mapping_source.assignment: src/flyonenomics/behaviour/encoder.py:19-36 assigns each side an even 0..150 degree grid by ascending root ID; lines 94-95 select it for TuBu
mapping_source.rate_equation: src/flyonenomics/behaviour/encoder.py:110-128 applies the Gaussian; sigma is 20 degrees
mapping_source.external_amplitude: src/flyonenomics/engine/brian_engine.py:461-478 gives every injected event w_in = w_syn*f_poi = 68.75 mV
mapping_source.timing: src/flyonenomics/behaviour/arena.py:120-142 presents the stripe throughout its block; the first 2 s are an analysis transition, not an encoder ramp

drive_matching.rule: On the fixed -150..150 degree census grid, set target total rate to the smallest 70-Hz encoder total, then set each position's maximum rate to target/sum(unit Gaussian). This uses the encoder alone, makes total injected Hz exact across positions, and never exceeds 70 Hz in any cell.

direct_tubu_to_er.definition: connectome signed edge count times lif.w_syn times the declared substrate transmitter scale; the per-position value further multiplies by the matched presynaptic encoder rate

encoder.stop_rule: Stop only if every cell-resolved injection distribution is identical.  Direct projections alone never trigger the stop.
encoder.position_rule: Choose the two endpoints of the imposed represented range and the two interior census-grid points that divide the 300-degree span into three equal 100-degree intervals: -150, -50, +50, +150 degrees.  This uses only encoder geometry and spans both sides.

analysis.input: integer count tensor (seed, 228 ER cells, dark/driven, stripe off + four positions)

primary.signed_response_definition: mu is the latent stripe-on raw mean minus that condition's latent stripe-off raw mean; it may be signed. b is an azimuth-independent evoked component.
primary.fit: leave one whole seed out; estimate all five raw means in each condition from training counts; fit a>=0 and b by generalised Deming regression using the full covariance from the shared off count. Dark and driven noise both enter Cy+a^2 Cx.
primary.comparison: held-seed variance-standardised raw-count prediction loss under the affine fit minus the condition-specific five-mean fit, summed over all 228 cells and averaged over folds
primary.noise: position- and condition-specific training variance, half sample variance and half historical NB target mean+alpha*mean^2, floor 0.25; historical alpha is frozen
primary.uncertainty: 2000 seed-block resamples; every resample reruns all LOSO fits; the interval uses bootstrap percentile deviations centered on the observed score
primary.detection: lower 2.5 percentile above zero; otherwise unresolved unless an external relevance bound exists

historical_variability.method: cellwise median arm mean and median max(0,(sample variance-mean)/mean^2) over every stage 1--3 arm; each arm contributes its ten per-seed 18-s counts

secondary.decoder: fixed nearest-centroid decoder of signed 228-cell response vectors, whole seeds held out, per-cell scaling learned inside each fold
secondary.null: affine-rate null: transform held-out and training dark response vectors with each fold's per-cell a,b before the same decoder; compare driven accuracy to this null
secondary.indices: report per-cell primary score and sums by hemibrain subtype; exploratory only

flat_outcome_bound.reason: No biological or behavioural calibration maps a change in this imposed TuBu label code, the cross-validated loss, or four-position decoder accuracy to scientific relevance.
